text:
We have a step by step guide on our website. The online application is the only option to start the partner visa process . If there are missing documents you‘ll have 45 days to fix it. Just after you uploaded all necessary paperwork you’ll receive an appointment to hand in the paperwork physically. 

https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
